arguments.prompt: Character turnaround model sheet of the small raccoon wearing a purple pointed wizard hat in the input image, drawn exactly as it is designed there. Three full-body views of the same animal on four legs, side by side on one sheet: FRONT view on the left, SIDE view in the middle facing right, BACK view on the right (the back view is the input image: dark grey-brown fur, round body, a thick tail with alternating dark charcoal and pale grey-cream rings, a tall purple pointed hat with a small wide brim and tiny yellow marks). In the front view show the dark eye mask, pale cheeks and muzzle, small black nose and rounded ears poking out beside the hat. Same low-poly faceted papercraft art style as the input: flat-shaded triangles, no outlines, muted colours. Flat even neutral lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, plain flat light grey background, no text, no labels, no watermark, the three views evenly spaced and the same scale.
arguments.negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, label, cast shadow, floor, smooth gradients, photorealistic, fur strands, cartoon outlines, extra characters, extra limbs
image_urls: <the raccoon cut from the reference still at 5-6x, uploaded by hf.py --upload>
